assumptions.choice: Use the highest high and lowest low from the most recent 50 hourly bars; an upward move requires the swing low to occur before the swing high, and a downward move requires the swing high to occur before the swing low.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define swing points or their lookback period.

assumptions.choice: Calculate all standard levels as swing_high minus the swing range multiplied by 0%, 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, 78.6%, and 100%.
assumptions.reason: This is the standard retracement orientation and makes the stated 78.6% long stop and 23.6% short stop lie on the required sides of their entries.

assumptions.choice: Require the candle range to touch the selected 38.2% or 61.8% level and its close to finish above that level for a long or below it for a short.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a confirming bounce candle but does not define its OHLC pattern.

assumptions.choice: Use the closest qualifying hourly low or high from the same 50-bar swing window.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define the search window for the nearest price extreme.

assumptions.choice: Use the immediately adjacent Fibonacci level in the profit direction, with the swing high/low used if no intermediate level exists.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not specify which level applies when multiple Fibonacci levels are above or below the entry.

assumptions.choice: Risk exactly 1% of current broker equity, using an integer position size calculated from entry-close to stop-loss distance.
assumptions.reason: The required 1-2% range does not select a specific percentage or share-rounding rule.

assumptions.choice: Derive a daily trend from the two most recently completed daily closes; buy only when the latest completed daily close is higher and sell only when it is lower.
assumptions.reason: Only one hourly feed is supplied, while the specification requires a higher-timeframe trend filter and gives daily as an example.

assumptions.choice: Use Backtrader Close orders for entries and RSI alternative exits.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires execution at the confirming candle close; exact same-bar close execution depends on harness broker cheat-on-close configuration.
